title: Status model declares the dashboard fields (contract, types, stubs)
description:
Wave 1 of epic hn6 (watch becomes a dashboard): declare, in ONE place, every new field the dashboard renders, so the wave-2 ticks fill them in parallel against a fixed shape. This tick adds the vocabulary, the contract, the Go types, stub builders in their own files, and the production wiring. It computes NOTHING new beyond the one trivial field `recent`. Every other new field comes out as null or empty, and the wave-2 ticks fill them in.

Background: `ticfac status --json` emits the status model `ticfac.status.v1` (package internal/statusmodel, tick 6dh). `ticfac watch` (internal/cli/watch_view.go), the bare `ticfac` overview (internal/cli/overview.go) and the phone page (cloudflare/src/phone.ts) all render it. The contract is internal/statusmodel/contract.json: a closed schema (additionalProperties false), golden documents that must validate and round-trip through the Go type, and negatives that must be refused.

Decision (logged here, standing order "internal API shape: decide and log"): the new fields are ADDITIVE within schema_version 1. They are required-and-null, or required-and-empty, following the model's existing convention. Do not bump SchemaVersion: the phone page's snapshot parser refuses any model version other than 1, and every reader of this contract lives in this repository.

New fields (exact JSON names; Go names follow the file's style):

1. Tick (statusmodel.go `Tick`):
   - `pipeline`: array of {`stage`, `state`}. `stage` is a closed enum: claim, work, review, gate, ci, merged, closed. `state` is a closed enum: pending, active, done, failed. The stage list per role is: implement tick [claim, work, gate, merged]; role review [claim, review, closed]; role closeout [claim, work, ci, closed]. Put these lists in the Go code as exported vars (PipelineImplement, PipelineReview, PipelineCloseout) and document them in the contract's description.
   - `parent_tick_id`: string or null. The tick this row is indented under (a repair tick or absorbed finding under its source tick). Null for a direct child of the epic.
   - `duration_seconds`: integer or null. From the first dispatch of the tick to its close, or to `now` while it is open.
   - `findings`: array of {`key`, `title`, `gating` (boolean or null)}. Empty when the tick has none.
   - `report`: {`summary` (string or null), `diff` ({`files`, `insertions`, `deletions`} integers, or null)} or null. Null means the report was not read.
2. Try (`Try`): add `tier` (string or null), `reason` (string or null) and `next_step` (string or null).
3. Worker (`Worker`):
   - `handle`: string or null. The executor's name for the worker, for example a herdr pane/agent name.
   - `activity`: {`window_seconds` (integer), `buckets` (array of integers, oldest first), `last_action` (string or null), `last_action_at` (string or null), `nudges` (integer)} or null.
4. Health (`Health`): add `verdict`: {`state` (closed enum: healthy, degraded, stopped), `summary` (string), `recovered` (array of {`what` (string), `count` (integer), `seconds` (integer or null)})}.
5. Cost (`Cost`): add `lines`: array of {`source` (closed enum: decisions, workers-ai, claude, pi-local, other), `metered` (boolean), `usd` (number or null; MUST be null when metered is false — add a negative golden that refuses metered:false with a number), `attempts` (integer), `basis` (string)}. Keep `recorded_usd`, `attempts` and `basis` as they are.
6. Model: `recent`: array of run-feed events (the same event shape `liveness.last_event` uses), holding the LAST 5 lines of the feed, oldest first. It is empty when the feed is empty. Fill it in build.go now; it is one slice expression.
7. Model: `epic_title`: string or null. The epic's title from src.Graph.Epic; null when the graph is unread. Tick: `gloss` (string, omitempty like `title`) from the graph task's Gloss. Fill both in build.go / buildTick now: they are direct copies.

Stub builders: create these files, each holding the function the wave-2 tick fills. Call each from Build() in build.go now, so no wave-2 tick edits build.go:
- internal/statusmodel/pipeline.go: `func decorateTicks(src Sources, recs Records, m *Model)`. It sets every tick's pipeline to its role's stage list, all pending; findings to []; parent, duration and tries' tier/reason/next_step to nil. Call it after buildWaves.
- internal/statusmodel/verdict.go: MOVE buildHealth there from build.go unchanged. Add `func buildVerdict(src Sources, m Model) HealthVerdict` returning {state: "healthy", summary: "", recovered: []}. Call it after buildWaits.
- internal/statusmodel/cost.go: MOVE buildCost there from build.go unchanged. It additionally returns `lines: []`.
- internal/statusmodel/activity.go: `func decorateWorkers(src Sources, recs Records, m *Model)`, a no-op that leaves activity and handle nil.
- internal/statusmodel/report.go: `func decorateReports(src Sources, m *Model)`, a no-op that leaves report nil.
New Sources fields, each nil-safe and nil by default:
- `Activity func(executor, worktree string) *ActivityInput` (ActivityInput: {Events []time.Time, LastAction string, LastActionAt time.Time}).
- `Report func(tickID string, attempt int) *ReportInput` (ReportInput: {Summary string, Files, Insertions, Deletions int, DiffRead bool}).
- `WorkerCost *WorkerCostInput` ({USD float64, Source string}).
Production wiring in internal/cli/status_model.go:
- localStatusModel passes `Activity: statusmodel.TranscriptActivity(home)` and `Report: statusmodel.AttemptReports(repo, runID)`. Both are exported constructors you create as stubs: TranscriptActivity in activity.go and AttemptReports in report.go. Each returns a func that returns nil.
- cloudStatusModel passes nil for both. If the factory's run JSON carries `cost_usd` (grep cloudflare/src/runs.ts and cloudflare/src/db.ts), add `CostUSD *float64 json:"cost_usd"` to cloudRunRecord in internal/cli/cloud.go and pass `WorkerCost: &WorkerCostInput{USD: *rec.CostUSD, Source: "gateway"}` when it is present.

Contract (internal/statusmodel/contract.json): add every field above to the schema. Update every existing golden so it validates, with the null/empty values. Add ONE new golden named "dashboard" with EVERY new field populated: a 4-tick epic (one closed implement tick with pipeline all done, one in-flight with gate active, one repair child with parent_tick_id set, one closeout with ci active), 2 tries with tier/reason/next_step on a rejected try, 1 worker with activity buckets and a handle, a verdict of "healthy" with recovered [{what:"net", count:14, seconds:null}], cost lines with one metered workers-ai line and one unmetered claude line (usd null), and 5 recent events. The wave-3 renderers and the phone page test against this golden. Add negatives: an unknown pipeline stage, metered:false with a number usd, and an unknown verdict state.

Files: internal/statusmodel/statusmodel.go, build.go, contract.json, contract_test.go (only if a helper needs it), build_test.go (only to keep existing assertions compiling), the new pipeline.go, verdict.go, cost.go, activity.go and report.go, internal/cli/status_model.go, internal/cli/cloud.go. Do NOT touch internal/cli/watch*.go, overview*.go or cloudflare/.

Tests:
- The existing contract tests must pass over the new golden: `go test -short -timeout 20m -run 'TestTheContract|TestTheGoType' ./internal/statusmodel/`.
- Add TestBuildEmitsTheDashboardFieldsEmpty (build_test.go or a new build_dashboard_test.go). A Build over the existing fixture sources yields: pipeline set per role with every stage pending, findings [], worker activity null, verdict state "healthy", cost lines [], and recent holding the last ≤5 feed events, oldest first (a feed of 7 events gives the last 5; a feed of 0 gives []), and epic_title plus tick gloss copied from the graph.
- Regression surface that must still pass: `go test -short -timeout 20m ./internal/statusmodel/ ./internal/cli/`.

[2] Stub builders live in pipeline.go, verdict.go, cost.go, activity.go, report.go, are called from Build, and are wired from localStatusModel/cloudStatusModel. [3] `make gate` passes.
